Chapter 487 - 487 Punishment; Apologize!

Chapter 487 - 487 Punishment; Apologize!

487 Punishment; Apologize!

In the eyes of the public, Mr. He was the leader of Rising Sun Group, Herrs was the leader of Jiawen Group, and Li Jiawei was the leader of Datong Group.

Even if these people just stomped their feet, some countries or even the entire world might even be shaken. They possessed extremely terrifying energy.

However, only Mr. He and Mr. Heers, and Mr. Li understood that everything they had was given to them by the Qing Hong Sect.

At the same time, it could be easily taken away!

Lin Fan was the current leader of the Qing Hong Sect, so how could Mr. He not respect him?

Although the man with the crew cut, the man with silver-rimmed glasses, the man with a buzz cut, the man smoking a cigar, and the others still did not understand Lin Fan’s identity, they followed suit and said respectfully, “Greetings, Mr. Lin.”

After all, he was someone who even Chairman He of Rising Sun Group had to treat respectfully.

How could they, the leaders of small forces, dare to be disrespectful?

Lin Fan turned his head and glanced at Mr. He and the others. He did not take it to heart.

Huo Qilong, the man with an ear stud, the man with light red hair, and the man in sunglasses standing on the luxury yacht shouted at the men on the large yacht.

“Dad!”

“Dad!”

“Dad, what’s going on?”

“Dad!”

The older men slowly turned around.

Only then did they realize that their sons were actually on the yacht beside theirs!

That was right!

Huo Qilong, the man with light red hair, the man with an ear stud, and the man wearing sunglasses were their sons!

Their minds began to work.

The yacht their sons were on was so close to Lin Fan’s yacht.

Could it be…

Did they know each other?

Thinking of this, the man with a crew cut was the first to speak. “Mr. Lin, I didn’t expect you to know my son. This is really surprising.”

“It’s my son’s honor to know you,” said the man wearing silver-rimmed glasses.

“And my son… Could it be that you’re also interested in games, Mr. Lin?”

Everyone spoke up, wanting to use their son to get closer to Lin Fan.

After all, Lin Fan was someone that even Mr. He had to treat with respect.

Lin Fan glanced at everyone and asked, “Them? I guess you can say that we know each other.

“After all, they were all teasing my girlfriend just now. Then, they asked me to kneel on the ground and slap myself 100 times.”

The hearts of the older men began to beat wildly.

Their sons had teased the girlfriend of a young man that even Mr. he had to treat with respect?

Then, they asked him to kneel on the ground and slap himself 100 times?

This…

They slowly turned their heads like machines.

Mr. He was staring at them with a pair of extremely cold eyes.

They were so frightened that they could not help but shiver.

“From now on, Rising Sun Group will not cooperate with all of you here!” Mr. He said coldly.

“I will even spare no effort to make you suffer the greatest punishment!”

The faces of the older men turned pale.

Almost half of their company’s business came from Rising Sun Group.

Once they were abandoned by Rising Sun Group, the consequences…

Moreover, they would be punished by Rising Sun Group.

They could almost imagine… how miserable they would be in the future.

The man with the crew cut was the first to react. He shouted at his son, the man with light red hair, “Bastard, kneel down and apologize to Mr. Lin!”

“Dad, I…” the red-haired man stuttered.

Seeing that his son did not apologize immediately, the man with the crew cut was furious again. “Damn it!”

He shouted at the captain of the yacht, “Please go to the yacht over there!”

The man smoking a cigar, the man wearing silver-rimmed glasses, the man with the buzz cut, and the others also shouted.

“Quickly apologize to Mr. Lin!”

“Apologize!”

Then, they jumped onto the deck of the luxury yacht and walked angrily toward their sons.

All of them slapped their sons’ faces.

They did not dare to hold back at all. Moreover, they continued to slap.

These slaps stunned the young men.

Soon, their faces became red and swollen.

The fathers all secretly looked at Lin Fan.

However, they saw that Lin Fan had no intention of stopping them.

Therefore, they shouted at their sons again.

“Kneel down!”

“Unfilial son, kneel down!”

“Kneel down and apologize!”

“Hurry!”

Huo Qilong, the man with an ear stud, the man with the light red hair, the man wearing sunglasses, and the rest now knew that Lin Fan had a powerful background. He was definitely someone they could not afford to offend.

Therefore, they all knelt on the ground and stammered, “Yes… I’m sorry, I must’ve been possessed just now…”

“I’m sorry, please don’t take offense…”

“Please spare us…”

“I’m sorry…”

Lin Fan said indifferently, “Do you still remember what I just said?”

The young men suddenly remembered.

“All of you kneel down and slap yourself ten times. Do that and I’ll consider not taking your words to heart.’

Although the faces of Huo Qilong and the others were already red and swollen, they did not hesitate and raised their hands to slap themselves.

Loud slaps echoed.

Soon, the ten slaps were over.

However, Lin Fan did not say anything.

Thus, Huo Qilong and the others did not dare to stop.

As time passed, Huo Qilong and the others had already started to bleed from the corners of their mouths, and their faces were slowly turning into pig heads.

Their fathers felt their hearts ache at this scene.

After all, they were their sons.

However, they did not dare to open their mouths.

After Huo Qilong and the others slapped themselves 100 times, Lin Fan finally opened his mouth and said, “Alright.”

Lin Fan’s thoughts were very simple.

At first, he only asked them to slap themselves 10 times.

However, they wanted to slap themselves 100 times.

Since that was the case, he would grant their wish!

At this moment, the faces of Huo Qilong and the others were completely swollen.

Lin Fan continued, “I don’t want something like this to happen again.”

The older men hurriedly said, “It won’t happen. We promise that such a thing will never happen again.”

Lin Fan did not care much about it. He nodded at Mr. He as a form of greeting.

Then, he said to the captain of the MJ Yacht, “Set sail!”

After a loud rumble, the yacht started to move.
